name: braid-based protein-folding operator as a braid group B_n acting
notes:
Auto-designed from: Design an Ob3ect for:

braid-based protein-folding operator as a braid group B_n acting on a conformation space of n res

phase_0.boundary_condition: the braid closure isotopic to the native protein fold
phase_0.domain_name: braid-based protein-folding operator as a braid group B_n acting
phase_0.justification: Auto-designed by the native Ob3ect Auto-Designer (in-process candle, no Python)

AFWD.chosen_element: crossing operator τ_i moving residue i past residue i+1 along the chain
AFWD.justification: the forward morphism applies a directed braid transformation that advances the folding word

AREV.chosen_element: inverse crossing operator τ_i^{-1} undoing a residue exchange
AREV.justification: the contravariant morphism descends the word by reversing a crossing and restoring the prior order

CLINK.chosen_element: sequential product τ_i τ_j composing adjacent crossing operators into a braid word
CLINK.justification: composition chains morphisms so each crossing acts on the conformation produced by the previous one

ENGAGR.chosen_element: residue simultaneously graded over- and under-crossing at an ambiguous crossing
ENGAGR.justification: the B state holds both truth and falsity live at once when the crossing admits two incompatible windings

EVALF.chosen_element: under-crossing arm graded as topologically rejected
EVALF.justification: the negative evaluator touches constructive falsity F when the crossing creates a non-native knot

EVALT.chosen_element: over-crossing arm graded as topologically acceptable
EVALT.justification: the affirmative evaluator touches constructive truth T when the crossing preserves native contact order

FFUSE.chosen_element: rejoined conformation after the over- and under-crossing arms resolve
FFUSE.justification: the multiplication μ rejoins the arms into one resolved state; conflicting crossing grades fuse to B rather than collapsing

FSPLIT.chosen_element: residue pair at a crossing opening into over-crossing and under-crossing arms
FSPLIT.justification: the co-multiplication δ opens one residue state into two mutually exclusive crossing configurations

IFIX.chosen_element: winding grade ⊡ written permanently into the residue's topological record
IFIX.justification: the ROM fixation appends an irreversible winding number that cannot be undone by later crossings

IMSCRIB.chosen_element: identity braid e leaving every residue in place
IMSCRIB.justification: the neutral self-reference acts on the conformation space without changing any residue position

TANCH.chosen_element: native-state loop boundary that contains the completed folded protein
TANCH.justification: the terminal anchor closes the braid word and fixes the system boundary at the native conformation

VINIT.chosen_element: uninitialized residue chain before any crossing operator acts
VINIT.justification: the void state contains no crossings, no winding grades, and no conformation assignments

phase_2.fuse_element: rejoined residue pair after μ∘δ closure
phase_2.fuse_result: one conformation state carrying the joined winding grade, or B when the arms carry conflicting grades
phase_2.rejoin_note: each arm applies its crossing operator and IFIX records its winding; the arms rejoin into a single state unless the fork remains open for a permanently divergent braid word
phase_2.split_input: single ungraded residue conformation before the crossing decision
split_outputs: over-crossing arm with forward winding grade
under-crossing arm with reverse winding grade
phase_2.verdict_reason: Tri-ancestral reconnection over a transformed object — closes

phase_3.both_description: B4 B (11) — both held at once: a live contradiction where a residue carries both over- and under-crossing grades
phase_3.false_description: B4 F (10) — constructively refuted / negated: under-crossing rejected as non-native
phase_3.true_description: B4 T (01) — constructively proven / affirmed: over-crossing accepted as native-compatible
phase_3.void_description: B4 N (00) — neither: uninitialized residue chain, no crossing or winding established

steps.domain_action: residue chain enters the operator with no crossings applied
identity braid e confirms the initial conformation is unchanged
residue pair at crossing τ_i opens into over- and under-crossing arms
over-crossing arm is affirmed as topologically acceptable
crossing operator τ_i advances residue i past residue i+1 on the over arm
winding grade ⊡ is permanently recorded for the over-crossing residue
under-crossing arm is refuted as topologically rejected
inverse crossing τ_i^{-1} descends the under arm to restore residue order
ambiguous crossing holds both over- and under-crossing grades simultaneously as B
over- and under-crossing arms rejoin into one resolved conformation state
resolved conformation composes with the next crossing operator in the braid word
reverse traversal descends the completed word to verify isotopy
braid closure closes into a loop isotopic to the native state and anchors the system

phase_5.alfs_store: native-state braid closure word stored as the canonical reference fold
phase_5.compiler_frontend: translates braid words into sequences of crossing operators τ_i and winding grades
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: residue states pass between adjacent crossing operators through shared conformation registers
phase_5.memory_mechanism: winding grades are stored in append-only ROM fixation per residue
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: orders crossing operators left to right along the braid word and schedules closure last

phase_6.cycle_cost: one winding grade fixation per crossing operation
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — each forward crossing is balanced by its reverse descent and the Frobenius closure μ∘δ=id conserves the state count
phase_6.post_cycle_state: closed loop conformation with permanent winding record
phase_6.pre_cycle_state: ungraded residue chain with open braid word
